purpose: company region (광역 지자체) for the company form, personalized search and optional company-region AI search; one source for Spring, React and FastAPI
decision: 2026-10-03 user decision (IMP-019 region part, rule change): plan A excludes only programs whose jurisdiction_name is a different 광역 지자체 than the company region; central ministries, public bodies, unmapped jurisdictions and nationwide programs stay. Plan 가: the company region is one of the 16 standard names below (data has one merged 전남광주통합특별시 instead of 광주광역시 and 전라남도); 2026-10-03 follow-up: retain the current jurisdiction candidate filter (distinct from question-region unapplied decision 나); V11 application approved with ASCII-space-only and ambiguous 광주시 prefix risks accepted, current dev affected values absent, prod company data absent per user, Spring accepts standard values only; Bundle2 supersedes the central-ministry blanket retention: retain company-region or nationwide programs using title_region_rule; mapped multi-region titles override jurisdiction, mapped central-ministry title regions restrict candidates, unknown title mappings remain fail-open. Explicit named DOCUMENT_QA may read other regions with a warning; missing/nonstandard company region applies no region filter.
alias_rule: legacy free-text values are converted once (migration V11) when the value, with whitespace removed, starts with an alias; the longest matching alias wins; a value matching no alias becomes NULL and is counted
jurisdiction_rule: jurisdiction_name values mapped here are local governments; a city / county / district jurisdiction is added here with its upper 광역 region (none exist in the 2026-10-03 data: 42 distinct values = 16 광역 + 26 central)
national_rule: central owners with a mapped leading regional title follow title regions; other central/unmapped owners remain, not proof of nationwide eligibility
unmapped_rule: fail open: a jurisdiction_name that is neither in jurisdiction_regions nor in national_jurisdictions is kept, because excluding an unknown owner could hide a valid nationwide program; new values are reviewed and added here
filter_rule: standard company_region: mapped multi-region title first, otherwise local jurisdiction, otherwise mapped leading title; unknown title/owner fail-open. Applied result records JURISDICTION / TITLE_REGION / NATIONWIDE_OR_UNMAPPED counts.
query_rule: query jurisdictions (Natural Filter) are intersected with the allowed set (company region jurisdictions + national + unmapped); if nothing remains the result is CONDITION_CONFLICT with conflict.kind region (company_region, query_jurisdictions) and no candidates; a query naming only central ministries is never a conflict
known_gaps: Title area is a proxy: central sample5/20 had no actual business-location restriction. Relocation, buyer/supplier roles and source metadata errors remain IMP-031/032.

title_region_rule.unknown_token: fail-open, do not claim nationwide eligibility
title_region_rule.precedence: mapped multiple title regions override local jurisdiction; single title region restricts central/unmapped owners; single local title retains jurisdiction rule
title_region_rule.basis: 2026-10-04 bundle2 user approval: company-region plus nationwide; title proxy is not actual eligibility, prior central sample5/20 had no region condition
